releaseNotes:
1. Video-Style Tower Movement: Long-press any tower marker to display the turquoise teardrop movement handle with 4 directional arrows.
2. Ergonomic Handle Dragging: Touch and drag the turquoise handle freely across the map with 1:1 invariant tracking; map panning is disabled during dragging.
3. Continuous Line Preview: Connected feeder transmission lines dynamically stretch and follow tower movement in real-time.
4. Atomic SQLite Persistence: Releasing the handle automatically saves updated geographical coordinates and connected polylines to the database.
5. Move Undo Support: One-tap 'UNDO' action in confirmation toast restores original database coordinates and polyline geometry.
6. Standard Marker Details: Normal tap opens tower details and full Marker Options sheet (Rename, Copy, Move, Delete).
